sourceObservation.authoredSelectorMeaning: The switch labels selectors 1 through 6 as specific picked-character checks.
sourceObservation.castleDefect: Every one of those six switch cases reads track[0], so selectors 2 through 6 alias the first party position.
sourceObservation.unaffectedModes: Selector 0 checks whether any character is picked; every other selector compares the absolute selector with the picked count.

playerFacingProblem: An authored check for the second through sixth party position silently tests the first position instead, so Tutorial's second-character demonstration and ordinary scenario branches return the wrong result.
realmz2ChosenResult: Selectors 1 through 6 test the corresponding one-based party position. Selector 0 and picked-count modes retain Castle's control flow and consume no RNG.
